name: Ahasbai
overview: Ahasbai is a male biblical figure identified as the father of Eliphelet, who is described as the son of the Maacathite. Beyond this unique attribute, Scripture does not provide additional details about his tribe or other personal notes.
namesAndTitles: The name Ahasbai means 'I seek refuge in YHWH,' reflecting a trust in the Lord. Another name associated in the context is Ur, meaning 'flame' or 'light,' though this name pertains to a different individual mentioned in the same scriptural passages.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Ahasbai is the father of Eliphelet, the son of the Maacathite, establishing a paternal relationship. No other family relationships are documented for Ahasbai beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Ahasbai's significance in the biblical narrative is primarily tied to his identification as the father of Eliphelet, one of David's warriors noted in the list of valiant men. His mention situates him within the historical and military context of King David's reign, highlighting his familial link to notable figures in Israel's history.
